text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun and I were invited to an 
event. The truth behind it, however...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Sparkling sunshine! Perfect weather for a 
wedding event☆ Let's make this photo shoot 
a huge success!
choice_data_list: You're fully fired up, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Because I was picked to be a model! Hurry 
and get changed, everyone's eyes are 
gonna—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Isn't that person looking 
around over there...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It really is Rice-san! Yay! Did you come 
to watch the event by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hyah... Y-Yes... Weddings just make me 
feel so happy... so I've been looking 
forward to it for ages.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So hurry up and finish training—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa! D-Did I just hear thunder 
...W-Rain!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden rain shower. I thought it was 
surely just a passing shower, but...

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, looks like it won't clear up. We 
could push through, but there are barely 
any spectators... Perhaps we should call 
it off for now...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm sorry... I'm so sorry! It's all 
Rice's fault, I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's all because Rice came here...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Plus, it's not getting 
canceled. A little rain won't wash away 
Maya's sparkle, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Nope! I'm gonna shine even brighter! You 
two just watch from right there☆"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong♪ Thanks for waiting, everyone☆ 
Let's kick off the event with Maya's 
parade~!

text_block_list.name: Female Customer (Fan)
text_block_list.text:
Maya-chan, you're so cute~! Ugh... if only 
the weather were nicer...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Even the rain is just an accessory for 
Maya♪ Look, watch this! Sparkle-sparkle☆

text_block_list.name: Male Customer (Fan)
text_block_list.text:
...!! You're right! The rain looks like 
sequins under the camera lights...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right?♪ But the real fun starts now! 
...3... 2... 1—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Sunshiiine☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Mayano-san was incredible...! Everyone 
started smiling... It was like she cast 
magic...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks☆ My dad taught me before how 
to read the clouds and tell when it's 
going to clear up~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
After all, Maya's papa is a pilot soaring 
through the skies! *Hmph*!
choice_data_list:
So that's how you used the rain as part of 
the performance.

So that's how you made the rain part of 
the performance!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! But what matters isn't the 
weather or what's on the event schedule! 
What matters is—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya will become everyone's sun!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya made a promise when she put on this 
outfit. That she'd make everyone sparkle 
with her sparkle.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because that's what it means to be a 
mature woman—the kind Maya looks up to!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...! ...U-Um, you know... Mayano-san, you 
and everyone else are all sparkling!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"And that made Rice want to do her best, 
too. My heart felt all sparkly. So... 
thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The event was so much fun~! But wait, but 
wait, next up is Maya's main event! The 
fireworks show!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Truth is, I wanted to watch it 
together in that outfit that lets me 
sparkle the brightest. Though it got dirty 
in the rain anyway."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Knocking you out will have to wait for 
next time then, Trainer-chan☆
choice_data_list:
You shine the brightest no matter what you 
wear, Mayano!

Let's do our best so we get invited back 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
M-Maya got... knocked out. ...He just 
proposed to meee~~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No need to be shy~! You mean you want to 
run together forever, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Now Trainer-chan's sun will always be 
Maya☆ I won't lose any races either~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Mayano Top Gun gave a playful, 
bubbly smile.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Getting invited next time, and the 
time after that. Becoming a Maya who suits 
this outfit even better, and then—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"A-And so... when I become that kind of 
Maya, ...um... forever, with Maya... so—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hya!? ——W-Whoa! Fireworks! L-Look, look, 
Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um... W-We saw the fireworks, so 
let's head back! I'm hungry, and... 
well...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey! Whatever I was going to say 
earlier... I promise I'll muster up the 
courage to tell you someday!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Wait for me, okay!
